# EDA for the Dime Dataset

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
pkgs <- c(
  "tidyverse", "vegan", "glue", "patchwork", "ggplot2", "readxl",
  "ggrepel", "ggpubr", "pheatmap", "ggplotify", "patchwork",
  "usedist", "reticulate", "lsa", "rtk", "logger", "openxlsx",
  "colorspace", "igraph", "data.table", "igraph", "SpiecEasi", "NetCoMi",
  "tidyverse", "tools"
)

for (pkg in pkgs) {
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

for (file in list.files("R", full.names = TRUE)) {
  source(file)
}
```

```{r load-data}
# Load the dataset
pth_sample_metadata <- "data/source/sample_metadata.csv"
tbl_sample_metadata <- read_metadata(pth_sample_metadata)
```
